title: PERSON–AI BIDIRECTIONAL FIT – A PROOF-OF-CONCEPT CASE STUDY OF AUGMENTED HUMAN–AI SYMBIOSIS IN MANAGEMENT DECISION-MAKING PROCESS
reasoning: The paper includes a significant component evaluating AI systems on ethical dimensions within a hiring case study. It specifically evaluates 'ethical and behavioural reliability' and critiques a general-purpose LLM for a 'false-positive ethical evaluation' while highlighting the symbiotic AI's ability to correctly perform 'ethical disqualification' based on historical integrity risks.
